description: Fresh EN pharmaceutical cold-chain evidence-admission domain.

units.title: Temperature excursion response
units.text: If vaccine storage temperature remains above 8 °C for more than 15 minutes, quarantine the affected trays and notify the responsible pharmacist before any dose is released.

units.title: Refrigerated dispatch precondition
units.text: Before a refrigerated shipment may leave the pharmacy, staff must confirm that the data logger is active, the insulated shipper is sealed, and the destination contact is available.

units.title: Receiving a cold shipment
units.text: On receipt, the technician stops the data logger, records the minimum and maximum temperatures, and attaches the logger report to the receiving record.

units.title: Logger calibration evidence
units.text: The current calibration certificate records the logger serial number, calibration date, reference standard, and next calibration due date.

units.title: Temperature excursion
units.text: A temperature excursion is a departure from the validated storage temperature range for a medicine or vaccine.

units.title: Cold-chain inventory fields
units.text: Inventory records include product name, lot number, expiry date, quantity, storage location, and shipment status.
